name: Related
description: A link the world has no type for yet. Say what it is with `label`, and what kind of link it is with `nature` — the world behaves by the nature even before anybody defines a type, and a label that keeps coming back is how a type gets defined at all.

relation.example: ring.relate(grandmother, "related", label="inherited from", description="passed down in 2019")
relation.reads: the ring is what Michael inherited from his grandmother

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: What the user calls this relation, in their words.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: The latest of this one's descriptions, as one string. Writing it adds a description; they all live there.

attributes.name: nature
attributes.description: What kind of link this is: related_to (they stand in some relation), kind_of (the subject is a narrower kind of the object), part_of (the subject is part of the object), same_as (one and the same), derived_from (the subject was worked out from the object).

what_to_say: what this link is, in the words the user used — what one of them is to the other, and since when
